address: 100F, Four Seasons Hotel, 5 Zhujiang West Road, Zhujiang New Town, Tianhe, Guangzhou, China Mainland
bio: Not even the breathtaking vistas of Pearl River or the galaxy-inspired interior outshine the edible artwork served here. Seafood is their strong suit – try the grilled carabinero in capsicum shellfish cream sauce. To take in the chef's vision, try the eight-course Experience menu with optional add-ons such as seafood platter or Tajima M7 tomahawk steak (great for sharing). The à la carte menu is short but sweet; check out the seasonal dishes, too....
